DECLARE f public."RegisteredPaymentFunding"; e public."PaymentExecution";
BEGIN
 IF coalesce(NEW."debtorSubjectKind" = 'public_cash',FALSE) OR coalesce(NEW."creditorSubjectKind" = 'public_cash',FALSE)
    OR coalesce(NEW."approvedPayerSubjectKind" = 'public_cash',FALSE) OR coalesce(NEW."payeeSubjectKind" = 'public_cash',FALSE)
    OR coalesce(NEW."costBearingCompanySubjectKind" = 'public_cash',FALSE) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'public cash is only the canonical actual payer, never another company role';
 END IF;
 IF NEW."sourceType" = 'payment_execution' THEN
   SELECT * INTO f FROM public."RegisteredPaymentFunding" WHERE "executionId" = NEW."sourceBusinessId";
 END IF;
 IF f."executionId" IS NOT NULL OR NEW."actualPayerSubjectKind" = 'public_cash' THEN
   SELECT * INTO e FROM public."PaymentExecution" WHERE "id" = f."executionId";
   IF NOT coalesce(NEW."sourceType" = 'payment_execution' AND NEW."sourceVersion" = 1
      AND NEW."factKind" = 'downstream_payment' AND NEW."entryKind" = 'original' AND NEW."direction" = 'outflow'
      AND NEW."currencyCode" = 'CNY' AND NEW."evidenceLevel" = 'A'
      AND NEW."operatingLevel" = CASE WHEN f."actualPayerKind" = 'public_cash' OR f."actualPayerId" = e."companyEntityIdSnapshot" THEN 'project' ELSE 'inter_subject' END
      AND NEW."occurredAt" = e."paidAt" AND NEW."confirmedAt" = e."createdAt"
      AND NEW."confirmedByUserId" = e."executedByUserId" AND NEW."recordedByUserId" = e."executedByUserId"
      AND NEW."sourceSnapshot"->>'paymentRequestId' = e."paymentRequestId" AND NEW."sourceSnapshot"->>'amountCents' = e."amountCents"::TEXT
      AND NEW."sourceSnapshot"->>'actualPayerId' = f."actualPayerId"
      AND NEW."sourceSnapshot"->>'actualPayerType' = CASE WHEN f."actualPayerKind" = 'public_cash' THEN 'public_cash' ELSE 'our_company' END
      AND NEW."basisSnapshot"->>'authority' = 'registered_payment_execution'
      AND NEW."basisSnapshot"->>'voucherPending' = 'true' AND NEW."basisSnapshot"->'voucherFileId' = 'null'::JSONB AND e."voucherFileId" IS NULL
      AND NEW."idempotencyKey" = 'payment_execution:' || NEW."sourceBusinessId"
      AND public."jg_registered_payment_source_matches"(NEW."sourceBusinessId",NEW."projectId",NEW."amountCents",NEW."actualPayerSubjectKind",NEW."actualPayerSubjectId")
      AND NEW."sourceSnapshot"->'registeredFunding'->>'accountId' = f."accountId"
      AND NEW."sourceSnapshot"->'registeredFunding'->>'balanceRegistrationId' = f."balanceRegistrationId"
      AND NEW."sourceSnapshot"->'registeredFunding'->>'openingTreatment' = f."openingTreatment"
      AND NEW."sourceSnapshot"->'registeredFunding'->'actualPayerSnapshot' = f."actualPayerSnapshot",FALSE) THEN
     RAISE EXCEPTION 'registered canonical fact must freeze this exact payment, source and payer';
   END IF;
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END

SELECT EXISTS (
   SELECT 1 FROM public."PaymentExecution" e
     JOIN public."PaymentRequest" request ON request."id" = e."paymentRequestId"
     JOIN public."RegisteredPaymentFunding" f ON f."executionId" = e."id"
     JOIN public."RegisteredFundAccount" a ON a."id" = f."accountId"
     JOIN public."FundAccountBalanceRegistration" r ON r."id" = f."balanceRegistrationId" AND r."accountId" = a."id"
   WHERE e."id" = execution_id AND e."paymentSubjectType" = 'our_company'
     AND request."projectId" = project_id AND e."amountCents" = amount_cents AND amount_cents > 0
     AND f."actualPayerKind" = payer_kind AND f."actualPayerId" = payer_id
     AND r."status" = 'confirmed'
     AND ((a."kind" = 'company' AND payer_kind = 'participating_company' AND a."companyEntityId" = payer_id
           AND f."actualPayerSnapshot"->>'companyEntityId' = payer_id AND pg_catalog.length(pg_catalog.btrim(f."actualPayerSnapshot"->>'name')) > 0)
       OR (a."kind" = 'public_cash' AND a."companyEntityId" IS NULL AND payer_kind = 'public_cash' AND payer_id = 'public_cash'
           AND f."actualPayerSnapshot"->>'scopeKey' = 'public_cash'))
     AND ((f."openingTreatment" = 'included' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public."RegisteredFundPaymentAllocation" p WHERE p."executionId" = e."id"))
       OR (f."openingTreatment" = 'not_included' AND (SELECT coalesce(pg_catalog.sum(p."amountCents"),0) FROM public."RegisteredFundPaymentAllocation" p WHERE p."executionId" = e."id") = amount_cents))
     AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public."RegisteredFundPaymentAllocation" p JOIN public."FundAccountSourceBatch" s ON s."id" = p."sourceBatchId" WHERE p."executionId" = e."id" AND (p."accountId" <> a."id" OR s."registrationId" <> r."id"))
     -- Permanent provenance freezes the round seen at successful insertion.
     -- Deliberately no current role/latest round/history-basis status here.
     AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public."RegisteredPaymentEvent" event
       JOIN public."ContractVersion" version ON version."id" = event."payload"->'writeAuthority'->>'contractVersionId'
       JOIN public."ApprovalInstance" approved_round ON approved_round."id" = event."payload"->'writeAuthority'->'approvalRound'->>'id'
       WHERE event."executionId" = e."id" AND event."payload"->>'executionId' = e."id"
       AND event."payload"->>'accountId' = a."id" AND event."payload"->>'balanceRegistrationId' = r."id"
       AND event."payload"->'writeAuthority'->>'schemaVersion' = '1'
       AND pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(event."payload"->'writeAuthority'->'contractHistoryRevision') = 'string'
       AND event."payload"->'writeAuthority'->>'contractHistoryRevision' ~ '^[0-9]+$'
       AND (f."contractHistoryConfirmation" IS NULL OR f."contractHistoryConfirmation"->'basis'->>'revision' = event."payload"->'writeAuthority'->>'contractHistoryRevision')
       AND event."payload"->'writeAuthority'->>'paymentRequestId' = e."paymentRequestId"
       AND event."payload"->'writeAuthority'->>'projectId' = request."projectId"
       AND event."payload"->'writeAuthority'->>'contractId' = request."contractId"
       AND version."id" = request."contractVersionId" AND version."contractId" = request."contractId"
       AND event."payload"->'writeAuthority'->>'sourceType' = request."sourceType"
       AND event."payload"->'writeAuthority'->>'sourceType' IN ('settlement','contract_due','contract_advance')
       AND event."payload"->'writeAuthority'->>'paymentSubjectType' = 'our_company'
       AND event."payload"->'writeAuthority'->>'signingSubjectType' = 'our_company'
       AND event."payload"->'writeAuthority'->>'requestStatusBeforeExecution' IN ('approved_pending_payment','partially_paid')
       AND event."payload"->'writeAuthority'->'approvalRound'->>'businessType' = 'payment_request'
       AND event."payload"->'writeAuthority'->'approvalRound'->>'businessId' = e."paymentRequestId"
       AND event."payload"->'writeAuthority'->'approvalRound'->>'flowType' = 'payment.approve'
       AND event."payload"->'writeAuthority'->'approvalRound'->>'status' = 'approved'
       AND approved_round."businessType" = 'payment_request' AND approved_round."businessId" = e."paymentRequestId" AND approved_round."flowType" = 'payment.approve'
       AND event."payload"->'writeAuthority'->'approvalRound'->>'createdAt' = public."jg_registered_timestamp_iso"(approved_round."createdAt"))
 );

functionProofs.body:
SELECT public."jg_registered_payment_source_matches"(execution_id,project_id,amount_cents,payer_kind,payer_id)
 AND EXISTS (
   SELECT 1 FROM public."RegisteredPaymentFunding" f JOIN public."PaymentExecution" e ON e."id" = f."executionId"
   WHERE f."executionId" = execution_id AND (
     (f."openingTreatment" = 'not_included' AND payer_kind = 'participating_company'
       AND impact_kind = 'company_project_funds_decrease' AND source_impact_key = impact_kind
       AND direction_key = 'decrease' AND idempotency_key = 'payment_execution:' || execution_id || ':funds')
     OR (f."openingTreatment" = 'not_included' AND payer_kind = 'public_cash'
       AND impact_kind = 'public_cash_funds_decrease' AND source_impact_key = impact_kind
       AND direction_key = 'decrease' AND idempotency_key = 'payment_execution:' || execution_id || ':funds')
     OR (payer_kind = 'participating_company' AND payer_id <> e."companyEntityIdSnapshot"
       AND impact_kind = 'inter_subject_balance_increase' AND source_impact_key = 'inter_subject_proxy_payment'
       AND direction_key = 'increase' AND idempotency_key = 'payment_execution:' || execution_id || ':proxy'
       AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public."InterEntityRelationshipEntry" entry WHERE entry."paymentExecutionId" = execution_id
         AND entry."sourceType" = 'registered_payment_execution' AND entry."sourceAggregateId" = execution_id
         AND entry."status" = 'confirmed' AND entry."entryKind" = 'proxy_payment' AND entry."direction" = 'increase'
         AND entry."originalDebtorCompanyId" = e."companyEntityIdSnapshot" AND entry."creditorCompanyId" = payer_id
         AND entry."amountCents" = amount_cents))
   )
 );

SELECT "revision" FROM public."RegisteredContractHistoryRevision" WHERE "contractId" = contract_id;
SELECT coalesce(row_value->>'takeoverStatus' = 'confirmed' AND row_value->>'historicalBalanceConfirmedAt' IS NOT NULL,FALSE);

DECLARE e public."PaymentExecution"; f public."RegisteredPaymentFunding"; request public."PaymentRequest";
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO STRICT e FROM public."PaymentExecution" WHERE "id" = entry."paymentExecutionId";
 SELECT * INTO STRICT f FROM public."RegisteredPaymentFunding" WHERE "executionId" = e."id";
 SELECT * INTO STRICT request FROM public."PaymentRequest" WHERE "id" = e."paymentRequestId";
 IF NOT coalesce(
   entry."sourceType" = 'registered_payment_execution' AND entry."sourceAggregateId" = e."id"
   AND entry."entryKind" = 'proxy_payment' AND entry."direction" = 'increase' AND entry."status" = 'confirmed'
   AND entry."adjustsEntryId" IS NULL AND entry."settlementCaseId" IS NULL
   AND entry."fundExecutionId" IS NULL AND entry."fundExecutionCaseId" IS NULL AND entry."executionAllocationLineId" IS NULL
   AND entry."evidenceFileId" IS NULL AND entry."evidenceClaimId" IS NULL AND entry."evidenceUploadedByUserId" IS NULL AND entry."evidenceContentSha256" IS NULL
   AND entry."authorizationEvidenceFileId" IS NULL AND entry."authorizationEvidenceContentSha256" IS NULL
   AND entry."reauthorizationReference" IS NULL AND entry."reauthorizedByUserId" IS NULL AND entry."reauthorizedAt" IS NULL
   AND entry."actualPayerVerificationEvidenceFileId" IS NULL AND entry."actualPayerVerificationContentSha256" IS NULL
   AND entry."projectId" = request."projectId" AND entry."contractId" = request."contractId" AND entry."contractVersionId" = request."contractVersionId"
   AND entry."originalDebtorCompanyId" = e."companyEntityIdSnapshot" AND entry."approvedPayerCompanyId" = e."companyEntityIdSnapshot"
   AND entry."creditorCompanyId" = f."actualPayerId" AND entry."creditorCompanyId" <> entry."originalDebtorCompanyId"
   AND entry."debtorSnapshot" = pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('companyEntityId',e."companyEntityIdSnapshot",'name',e."companyEntityNameSnapshot",'creditCode',e."companyEntityCreditCodeSnapshot")
   AND entry."approvedPayerSnapshot" = entry."debtorSnapshot" AND entry."creditorSnapshot" = f."actualPayerSnapshot"
   AND entry."amountCents" = e."amountCents" AND entry."currencyCode" = 'CNY'
   AND entry."sourceAllocationCount" = 1 AND entry."sourceAllocationAmountCents" = e."amountCents"
   AND entry."idempotencyKey" = 'registered-payment:' || e."id" || ':intercompany' AND entry."payloadFingerprint" = f."payloadFingerprint"
   AND entry."createdByUserId" = e."executedByUserId" AND entry."confirmedByUserId" = e."executedByUserId" AND entry."confirmedAt" IS NOT NULL
   AND pg_catalog.length(pg_catalog.btrim(entry."reason")) > 0
   AND public."jg_registered_payment_source_matches"(e."id",request."projectId",e."amountCents",'participating_company',entry."creditorCompanyId"),FALSE)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'registered intercompany root does not match its one canonical payment and frozen container'; END IF;
END

SELECT * FROM public.jg_file_business_binding_columns_before_registered_payment()
 UNION ALL VALUES ('RegisteredPaymentVoucher','fileId',TRUE);

WITH records AS (
   SELECT t."id", t."historicalPaidCents" <> 0 OR t."historicalProxyPaidCents" <> 0 OR t."historicalAdvancePaidCents" <> 0 AS has_paid,
     '{"id":' || pg_catalog.to_json(t."id")::TEXT || ',"contractId":' || pg_catalog.to_json(t."contractId")::TEXT ||
     ',"contractVersionId":' || pg_catalog.to_json(t."contractVersionId")::TEXT || ',"paymentTermsVersionId":' || pg_catalog.to_json(t."paymentTermsVersionId")::TEXT ||
     ',"updatedAt":' || pg_catalog.to_json(public."jg_registered_timestamp_iso"(t."updatedAt"))::TEXT ||
     ',"confirmedAt":' || pg_catalog.to_json(public."jg_registered_timestamp_iso"(t."historicalBalanceConfirmedAt"))::TEXT ||
     ',"activatedAt":' || coalesce(pg_catalog.to_json(public."jg_registered_timestamp_iso"(t."activatedAt"))::TEXT,'null') ||
     ',"historicalPaidCents":' || pg_catalog.to_json(t."historicalPaidCents"::TEXT)::TEXT ||
     ',"historicalProxyPaidCents":' || pg_catalog.to_json(t."historicalProxyPaidCents"::TEXT)::TEXT ||
     ',"historicalAdvancePaidCents":' || pg_catalog.to_json(t."historicalAdvancePaidCents"::TEXT)::TEXT || '}' AS canonical
   FROM public."ContractTakeover" t WHERE t."contractId" = contract_id AND t."takeoverStatus" = 'confirmed' AND t."historicalBalanceConfirmedAt" IS NOT NULL
 ), revision_state AS (
   SELECT public."jg_registered_history_read_revision"(contract_id) AS value
 ), grouped AS (
   SELECT coalesce(pg_catalog.bool_or(has_paid),FALSE) AS required,
     '[' || coalesce(pg_catalog.string_agg(canonical,',' ORDER BY "id"),'') || ']' AS canonical_records FROM records
 )
 SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('required',required,'revision',revision_state.value::TEXT,'records',canonical_records::JSONB,
   'fingerprint',pg_catalog.encode(public.digest(pg_catalog.convert_to('{"contractId":' || pg_catalog.to_json(contract_id)::TEXT || ',"revision":' || pg_catalog.to_json(revision_state.value::TEXT)::TEXT || ',"records":' || canonical_records || '}','UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex'))
 FROM grouped CROSS JOIN revision_state;

steps.new:
PERFORM participant."id"
    FROM "ProjectParticipatingCompany" participant
    WHERE participant."projectId" = NEW."projectId"
      AND (
        participant."companyEntityId" = ANY (ARRAY[
          CASE WHEN NEW."debtorSubjectKind" = 'participating_company' THEN NEW."debtorSubjectId" ELSE NULL END,
          CASE WHEN NEW."creditorSubjectKind" = 'participating_company' THEN NEW."creditorSubjectId" ELSE NULL END,
          CASE WHEN NEW."approvedPayerSubjectKind" = 'participating_company' THEN NEW."approvedPayerSubjectId" ELSE NULL END,
          CASE WHEN NEW."actualPayerSubjectKind" = 'participating_company' THEN NEW."actualPayerSubjectId" ELSE NULL END,
          CASE WHEN NEW."payeeSubjectKind" = 'participating_company' THEN NEW."payeeSubjectId" ELSE NULL END,
          CASE WHEN NEW."costBearingCompanySubjectKind" = 'participating_company' THEN NEW."costBearingCompanySubjectId" ELSE NULL END
        ]::TEXT[])
        OR participant."companyEntityVersionId" = ANY (ARRAY[
          CASE WHEN NEW."debtorSubjectKind" = 'participating_company' THEN NEW."debtorSubjectId" ELSE NULL END,
          CASE WHEN NEW."creditorSubjectKind" = 'participating_company' THEN NEW."creditorSubjectId" ELSE NULL END,
          CASE WHEN NEW."approvedPayerSubjectKind" = 'participating_company' THEN NEW."approvedPayerSubjectId" ELSE NULL END,
          CASE WHEN NEW."actualPayerSubjectKind" = 'participating_company' THEN NEW."actualPayerSubjectId" ELSE NULL END,
          CASE WHEN NEW."payeeSubjectKind" = 'participating_company' THEN NEW."payeeSubjectId" ELSE NULL END,
          CASE WHEN NEW."costBearingCompanySubjectKind" = 'participating_company' THEN NEW."costBearingCompanySubjectId" ELSE NULL END
        ]::TEXT[])
      )
      AND participant."effectiveFrom" <= NEW."occurredAt"::DATE
      AND (participant."endedAt" IS NULL OR participant."endedAt" > NEW."occurredAt"::DATE)
    ORDER BY participant."id" FOR SHARE;

  FOREACH candidate_company_id IN ARRAY ARRAY[
    CASE WHEN NEW."debtorSubjectKind" = 'participating_company' THEN NEW."debtorSubjectId" ELSE NULL END,
    CASE WHEN NEW."creditorSubjectKind" = 'participating_company' THEN NEW."creditorSubjectId" ELSE NULL END,
    CASE WHEN NEW."approvedPayerSubjectKind" = 'participating_company' THEN NEW."approvedPayerSubjectId" ELSE NULL END,
    CASE WHEN NEW."actualPayerSubjectKind" = 'participating_company' THEN NEW."actualPayerSubjectId" ELSE NULL END,
    CASE WHEN NEW."payeeSubjectKind" = 'participating_company' THEN NEW."payeeSubjectId" ELSE NULL END,
    CASE WHEN NEW."costBearingCompanySubjectKind" = 'participating_company' THEN NEW."costBearingCompanySubjectId" ELSE NULL END
  ]::TEXT[] LOOP
    IF candidate_company_id IS NULL THEN CONTINUE; END IF;
    IF NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM "ProjectParticipatingCompany" participant
      WHERE participant."projectId" = NEW."projectId"
        AND (
          participant."companyEntityId" = candidate_company_id
          OR participant."companyEntityVersionId" = candidate_company_id
        )
        AND participant."effectiveFrom" <= NEW."occurredAt"::DATE
        AND (participant."endedAt" IS NULL OR participant."endedAt" > NEW."occurredAt"::DATE)
    ) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION '经营事实引用的我方公司未在本项目事实日参与'
        USING ERRCODE = '23514';
    END IF;
  END LOOP;

steps.old: CASE WHEN NEW."actualPayerSubjectKind" = 'participating_company' THEN NEW."actualPayerSubjectId" ELSE NULL END
steps.new: CASE WHEN NEW."actualPayerSubjectKind" = 'participating_company' THEN CASE WHEN NEW."sourceType" = 'payment_execution' AND public."jg_registered_payment_source_matches"(NEW."sourceBusinessId",NEW."projectId",NEW."amountCents",NEW."actualPayerSubjectKind",NEW."actualPayerSubjectId") THEN NULL ELSE NEW."actualPayerSubjectId" END ELSE NULL END

steps.old:
IF NEW."subjectKind" = 'participating_company' AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM "ProjectParticipatingCompany" participant
     WHERE participant."projectId" = NEW."projectId"
       AND (NEW."subjectId" = participant."companyEntityId"
         OR NEW."subjectId" = participant."companyEntityVersionId")
       AND participant."effectiveFrom" <= fact_occurred_at::DATE
       AND (participant."endedAt" IS NULL
         OR participant."endedAt" > fact_occurred_at::DATE)
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION '影响分录引用的我方公司未在本项目事实日参与'
      USING ERRCODE = '23514';
  END IF;

IF NOT FOUND THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION '影响分录引用的我方公司未在本项目事实日参与'
steps.new:
IF NOT FOUND AND NOT coalesce(NEW."sourceType" = 'payment_execution' AND NEW."subjectRole" = 'actual_payer' AND public."jg_registered_payment_impact_matches"(NEW."sourceBusinessId",NEW."projectId",NEW."amountCents",NEW."subjectKind",NEW."subjectId",NEW."impactKind",NEW."sourceImpactKey",NEW."direction",NEW."idempotencyKey"),FALSE) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION '影响分录引用的我方公司未在本项目事实日参与'

functionProofs.body:
DECLARE
  root_entry RECORD;
  claim_record RECORD;
  execution_record RECORD;
  attestation_record RECORD;
  confirmed_decreased_amount BIGINT;
BEGIN
  IF TG_OP = 'INSERT' AND NEW."sourceType" = 'registered_payment_execution' AND NEW."entryKind" = 'proxy_payment' THEN
    PERFORM public."jg_assert_registered_payment_relationship"(NEW);
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;
  IF TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN
    NEW."status" := 'draft';
  END IF;
  IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'inter_entity_relationship_entry_append_only';
  END IF;
  IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' THEN
    IF OLD."status" = 'confirmed' THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'inter_entity_relationship_entry_immutable';
    END IF;
    IF NEW."id" <> OLD."id"
       OR NEW."entryKind" <> OLD."entryKind"
       OR NEW."direction" <> OLD."direction"
       OR NEW."adjustsEntryId" IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."adjustsEntryId"
       OR NEW."paymentExecutionId" IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."paymentExecutionId"
       OR NEW."settlementCaseId" IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."settlementCaseId"
       OR NEW."originalDebtorCompanyId" <> OLD."originalDebtorCompanyId"
       OR NEW."creditorCompanyId" <> OLD."creditorCompanyId"
       OR NEW."approvedPayerCompanyId" <> OLD."approvedPayerCompanyId"
       OR NEW."debtorSnapshot" IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."debtorSnapshot"
       OR NEW."creditorSnapshot" IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."creditorSnapshot"
       OR NEW."approvedPayerSnapshot" IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."approvedPayerSnapshot"
       OR NEW."amountCents" <> OLD."amountCents"
       OR NEW."currencyCode" <> OLD."currencyCode"
       OR NEW."evidenceFileId" <> OLD."evidenceFileId"
       OR NEW."evidenceClaimId" IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."evidenceClaimId"
       OR NEW."evidenceUploadedByUserId" IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."evidenceUploadedByUserId"
       OR NEW."evidenceContentSha256" IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."evidenceContentSha256"
       OR NEW."authorizationEvidenceFileId" IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."authorizationEvidenceFileId"
       OR NEW."authorizationEvidenceContentSha256" IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."authorizationEvidenceContentSha256"
       OR NEW."reauthorizationReference" IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."reauthorizationReference"
       OR NEW."reauthorizedByUserId" IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."reauthorizedByUserId"
       OR NEW."reauthorizedAt" IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."reauthorizedAt"
       OR NEW."actualPayerVerificationEvidenceFileId" IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."actualPayerVerificationEvidenceFileId"
       OR NEW."actualPayerVerificationContentSha256" IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."actualPayerVerificationContentSha256"
       OR NEW."reason" IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."reason"
       OR NEW."idempotencyKey" <> OLD."idempotencyKey"
       OR NEW."payloadFingerprint" <> OLD."payloadFingerprint"
       OR NEW."createdByUserId" <> OLD."createdByUserId"
       OR NEW."createdAt" <> OLD."createdAt" THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'inter_entity_relationship_entry_identity_immutable';
    END IF;
    IF OLD."status" <> 'draft' OR NEW."status" <> 'confirmed' THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'inter_entity_relationship_entry_transition_invalid';
    END IF;
  END IF;
  IF NEW."status" = 'draft'
     AND (NEW."confirmedByUserId" IS NOT NULL OR NEW."confirmedAt" IS NOT NULL) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'inter_entity_relationship_entry_draft_audit_invalid';
  END IF;
  IF NEW."status" = 'confirmed'
     AND (NEW."confirmedByUserId" IS NULL OR NEW."confirmedAt" IS NULL) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'inter_entity_relationship_entry_confirmation_audit_invalid';
  END IF;

  IF NEW."status" = 'confirmed' AND NEW."entryKind" = 'proxy_payment' THEN
    SELECT version."companyEntityIdSnapshot" AS approved_payer_company_id,
           execution."paymentRequestId" AS payment_request_id,
           request."projectId" AS project_id,
           request."contractId" AS contract_id,
           request."paymentSubjectType" AS request_subject_type,
           version."contractId" AS version_contract_id,
           version."companyEntityIdSnapshot" AS version_company_id,
           version."signingSubjectType" AS signing_subject_type,
           contract."projectId" AS contract_project_id,
           contract."contractTypeKey" AS contract_type_key,
           execution."paymentSubjectType" AS execution_subject_type,
           case_row."status" AS case_status
    INTO execution_record
    FROM "PaymentExecution" execution
    INNER JOIN "PaymentRequest" request ON request."id" = execution."paymentRequestId"
    INNER JOIN "ContractVersion" version ON version."id" = request."contractVersionId"
    INNER JOIN "Contract" contract ON contract."id" = request."contractId"
    INNER JOIN "PayableSettlementCase" case_row ON case_row."id" = NEW."settlementCaseId"
    WHERE execution."id" = NEW."paymentExecutionId"
      AND case_row."paymentExecutionId" = execution."id";
    IF NOT FOUND
       OR execution_record.execution_subject_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'our_company'
       OR execution_record.request_subject_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'our_company'
       OR execution_record.signing_subject_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'our_company'
       OR execution_record.contract_type_key IS DISTINCT FROM 'labor_subcontract'
       OR execution_record.project_id IS DISTINCT FROM execution_record.contract_project_id
       OR execution_record.version_contract_id IS DISTINCT FROM execution_record.contract_id
       OR execution_record.version_company_id IS DISTINCT FROM execution_record.approved_payer_company_id
       OR execution_record.case_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'confirmed'
       OR NEW."approvedPayerCompanyId" IS DISTINCT FROM execution_record.approved_payer_company_id THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'inter_entity_relationship_scope_invalid';
    END IF;
    SELECT attestation.* INTO attestation_record
    FROM "PaymentExecutionPayerAttestation" attestation
    WHERE attestation."paymentExecutionId" = NEW."paymentExecutionId";
    IF NOT FOUND
       OR attestation_record."holderCompanyEntityId" IS DISTINCT FROM NEW."creditorCompanyId"
       OR attestation_record."verificationEvidenceFileId" IS DISTINCT FROM NEW."actualPayerVerificationEvidenceFileId"
       OR attestation_record."verificationEvidenceContentSha256" IS DISTINCT FROM NEW."actualPayerVerificationContentSha256"
       OR attestation_record."proxyAuthorizationEvidenceFileId" IS DISTINCT FROM NEW."authorizationEvidenceFileId"
       OR attestation_record."proxyAuthorizationEvidenceSha256" IS DISTINCT FROM NEW."authorizationEvidenceContentSha256"
       OR attestation_record."proxyAuthorizationReason" IS DISTINCT FROM NEW."reason"
       OR attestation_record."reauthorizationReference" IS DISTINCT FROM NEW."reauthorizationReference"
       OR attestation_record."reauthorizedByUserId" IS DISTINCT FROM NEW."reauthorizedByUserId"
       OR attestation_record."reauthorizedAt" IS DISTINCT FROM NEW."reauthorizedAt" THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'inter_entity_relationship_payer_attestation_invalid';
    END IF;
  END IF;

  IF NEW."status" = 'confirmed' AND NEW."entryKind" = 'proxy_return' THEN
    SELECT root.* INTO root_entry
    FROM "InterEntityRelationshipEntry" root
    WHERE root."id" = NEW."adjustsEntryId"
      AND root."entryKind" = 'proxy_payment'
      AND root."direction" = 'increase'
      AND root."status" = 'confirmed'
      AND root."adjustsEntryId" IS NULL
    FOR UPDATE;
    IF NOT FOUND
       OR NEW."originalDebtorCompanyId" IS DISTINCT FROM root_entry."originalDebtorCompanyId"
       OR NEW."creditorCompanyId" IS DISTINCT FROM root_entry."creditorCompanyId"
       OR NEW."approvedPayerCompanyId" IS DISTINCT FROM root_entry."approvedPayerCompanyId"
       OR NEW."currencyCode" IS DISTINCT FROM root_entry."currencyCode"
       OR NEW."debtorSnapshot" IS DISTINCT FROM root_entry."debtorSnapshot"
       OR NEW."creditorSnapshot" IS DISTINCT FROM root_entry."creditorSnapshot"
       OR NEW."approvedPayerSnapshot" IS DISTINCT FROM root_entry."approvedPayerSnapshot" THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'inter_entity_relationship_return_lineage_invalid';
    END IF;
    SELECT claim.* INTO claim_record
    FROM "InterEntityRelationshipEvidenceClaim" claim
    WHERE claim."id" = NEW."evidenceClaimId"
      AND claim."relationshipEntryId" = root_entry."id"
      AND claim."fileId" = NEW."evidenceFileId"
      AND claim."uploadedByUserId" = NEW."evidenceUploadedByUserId"
      AND claim."contentSha256" = NEW."evidenceContentSha256"
      AND claim."status" = 'consumed';
    IF NOT FOUND THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'inter_entity_relationship_return_evidence_claim_invalid';
    END IF;
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(entry."amountCents"), 0)
    INTO confirmed_decreased_amount
    FROM "InterEntityRelationshipEntry" entry
    WHERE entry."adjustsEntryId" = root_entry."id"
      AND entry."entryKind" = 'proxy_return'
      AND entry."direction" = 'decrease'
      AND entry."status" = 'confirmed'
      AND entry."id" <> NEW."id";
    IF confirmed_decreased_amount + NEW."amountCents" > root_entry."amountCents" THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'inter_entity_relationship_return_balance_invalid';
    END IF;
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
